in_arabic.name: لاكيا
in_arabic.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root 'L-K-Y' which means 'to be light, to shine'. The name Lakia is a variant of the name Layla, which also means 'night' in Arabic, but Lakia specifically emphasizes the radiant or shining aspect of the name.

in_urdu.name: لاکیا
in_urdu.long_meaning: In Urdu, the name Lakia translates to 'radiant, shining one' or 'advertiser, promoter'. This meaning is derived from the Arabic root 'L-K-Y' which has the connotation of 'to be light, to shine'.

in_hindi.name: लाकिया
in_hindi.long_meaning: In Hindi, the name Lakia translates to 'lamp, source of light' or 'astrologer, jyotish'. This meaning is also derived from the Arabic root 'L-K-Y' which has the connotation of 'to be light, to shine'.

in_pashto.name: لاکیا
in_pashto.long_meaning: In Pashto, the name Lakia translates to 'red, rosy' or 'radiant, shining one'. This meaning is also derived from the Arabic root 'L-K-Y' which has the connotation of 'to be light, to shine'.
